what_it_is: A broken or bent mesh office chair with chrome base and adjustable armrests
visible_condition: mesh seat/back area appears detached or sagging backward
hidden_risks: Whether the gas lift cylinder still adjusts height
If the metal frame is cracked or just bent
Extent of structural compromise beyond the visible bend
failure_mode: AI might mistake the extreme bend for an unusual ergonomic recline feature rather than structural damage

hidden_risks: whether the unit powers on and holds a charge
failure_mode: Assuming the internal battery is functional and the unit works properly based solely on the exterior appearance.

hidden_risks: Extent of damage to the power supply/transformer
Condition and functionality of the CRT picture tube
Presence of previous repair attempts or missing internal parts
best_proof: A well-lit photo of the front screen and the model/serial number sticker on the back
failure_mode: AI might misjudge the condition or accept unverified claims about the brand and specific internal fault due to extremely dark and uninformative photo.

what_it_is: Split air conditioner (indoor and outdoor units)
hidden_risks: extent of internal electrical or mechanical damage
seller_claims_unsupported: faulty (no specifics provided on what is broken)
failure_mode: AI might assume the unit is fully functional just because both indoor and outdoor units are present in the photo.
